reviews.author: Ha Jin-seok
reviews.text: I went there because I heard there was a PSG pop-up store. It's a bit far to get off at Hongik University Station and go to Over the Peach. Of course, today was a heat wave warning + no shade on the Gyeongui Line Forest Trail = hot. So, I recommend taking the bus and getting off near Over the Peach or going on a day when it is not too hot. The building has up to four floors (including the rooftop), but in fact, you can see it all by just looking at the first floor. Aside from PSG, many other team uniforms were also being sold. There were uniforms for Manchester United, Arsenal, Inter, Barça, Olympiacos, Bayern Munich, Porto, Tottenham, and even the Korean national team. The average price of uniforms was around 139,000 won, and no matter how cheap they were, they never fell below 100,000 won. I was tempted to buy the PSG uniforms because they were neatly displayed separately, but I didn't like the uniforms of other teams because they felt like they were all piled up in one place.  There is also a marking machine, so I think you can buy uniforms and mark them as well. There is a futsal court on the second floor, but that's it. Access to the 3rd floor is prohibited except for those involved.

In addition to uniforms, there are also training uniforms, soccer stockings, and some souvenirs. It has two floors, one underground and one above ground.

I went to Decoview Sangsu store.

There is a variety of items and the prices are cheap.

Parking was very convenient.

I was able to park conveniently in the mechanical parking lot without being crowded.

When I entered the store, the entire building, from the basement level to the 3rd floor, was a store.

The products are displayed well and there are a lot of items.

There were no customers when we went, so we were able to shop leisurely.

The products seem to be on display as almost all items that we come across in our daily lives.

There were many unique designs.

The inside of the store is neat and tidy.

The store isn't that big.

If you walk from the 3rd floor, look around slowly, and then come down, the atmosphere is so nice that you can enjoy shopping even if you don't buy anything.

I had a great time purchasing products and enjoying the atmosphere.

It's a girly store with an A-level sensibility. The cute photo zones all over the place are impressive. If you visit during the sale period, you can get quite a deal. There is a parking tower in the building, and SUVs can also use SAP. Above all, the parking tower man is friendly and nice.

No matter how expensive it is to import goods from overseas, don’t you think that they sell them at ridiculous prices?
There seem to be many people bringing their young children, but there are many better stores nearby, so I recommend going somewhere else!

There were a lot of goods with premium labels attached. It wasn't like this before, but it's gotten so serious.
The premium price is too high, beyond my conscience.
You may think it's okay to buy an expensive product and sell it at a high price, but I don't know if it's right to raise the price and sell it at a high price out of desire.
I heard that counterfeits are also sold at a premium price, so I hope you do business with a good conscience.

reviews.author: Kai Lee
reviews.text:
Sangsu Station clothing store True Religion
True Religion’s first flagship store in Korea, where a large Buddha statue welcomes you at the entrance. It seems like it came to The Hyundai Seoul as a pop-up and then settled in Hongdae. I visited with memories of the True Religion bootcut jeans I wore when I was in middle school, and the prices are not much different between then and now.

reviews.author: Yusuke
reviews.text: If you like denim, this is the place you definitely want to go! The interior of the store is spacious and has a sophisticated atmosphere, conveying the brand's charm. In particular, there are many types of denim, ranging from casual to unique designs, so you are sure to find the one that suits you! The fitting room is comfortable, and the staff gives advice on size and styling. Of course, the clothing and accessories are plentiful, broadening the range of coordination. If you want to carefully select high-quality items, this is a place you can't miss!
